name: Gudbrandsdalsleden (Skaun-Nidaros)
description_md:
Gudbrandsdalsleden (Skaun-Nidaros) is a waymarked hiking route in Norway covering 46.8 km. The path involves 997 m of ascent and 1112 m of descent, requiring about 14 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is classified as hard, derived from distance and ascent, and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen. During the journey, the path passes Nidaros Cathedral within 100 m and Trondheim within 200 m.
